# Vendor

Pinned upstream sources used by Symphonia builds.

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `ghostty.pin` | Commit SHA for [ghostty-org/ghostty](https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty) |
| `ghostty/` | Local checkout (gitignored) — created by `Terminal/scripts/build-ghosttykit.sh` |

Do not commit `ghostty/` or built `Terminal/GhosttyKit.xcframework`.
